appDesc.message: Highlights Angular components when change detection runs - like React DevTools

jevHint.message: Jev (TypeSafe AI) automatically detects excessive re-rendering. While enabled, only the component name, re-render count, and change detection strategy are sent to the Jev API (no page content). Your API key is stored locally on this device only.

jevThresholdLabel.message: Diagnose at N re-renders in 2 sec

jevThresholdNote.message: Up to 13. Zone.js detection records at most once per 150 ms, so higher values are less likely to trigger.

jevCauseParentPropagation.message: Re-rendered along with its parent component

jevCauseEventHandlerRecreation.message: Functions or objects are recreated on every render
